sections.heading: Swaps for v3
sections.note: Both swaps together take the draw count from 7 to 9. With both, average MV goes 3.40 → 3.43, MV ≤ 2 stays at 24 and MV ≤ 3 goes 42 → 41.

why: It gives Iron Man, an artifact creature, "draw a card" whenever he deals combat damage to a player, and Brotherhood Regalia makes him unblockable.
The draw is his own ability, so Wizard's Staff and Roaming Throne each add one more (ledger equip-018). Double strike and extra combats multiply it again.
Manifold Key's unblockable mode was v3's evasion until Brotherhood Regalia took that job on 2026-11-10.
flags: You lose Key's {1} untap, and the backup evasion if Regalia is answered.
During the Aggravated Assault loop the draws aren't optional, so watch your library.

why: It's a {1}{U} 0/4 artifact creature that draws every turn. v3's 36 land slots hold 30 different names, so it stops discarding at five lands about 83% of the time.
It doesn't need Iron Man flipped or attacking, it deploys for free, and it blocks.
flags: You've kept Cloud Key four times without giving a reason. If the reason is surviving creature wipes, this swap leaves every cost reducer a creature.

options.note: The cleaner curve swap if you turn down Adjutant.
You declined it as a cut twice on 2026-11-10.

why: Tap her for {2} aimed at Iron Man and leave her tapped, and each of his triggers fires again: the combat deploy, The Reaver Cleaver's Treasures, Infantry Shield's mobilize, and Adjutant's draw if you take it.
She stacks with Wizard's Staff and Roaming Throne, because each adds one more trigger (CR 603.2d). She passes the MV 2 rule.
Your ground on Scarlet Witch was that she needs a creature with a trigger already on the board. Here that's the commander, as on Lord of Pain and Vision.
flags: The review passed on her. A second deploy needs a second artifact in hand, and cards in hand are what this deck runs short of.
She isn't an artifact, so the reducers don't discount her and the combat deploy can't put her in.
She has no cut named yet. Say if you want her, and I'll rank one.

pairs.note: Its planeswalker lock hits every player.
It phases Iron Man out with his Equipment, and he comes back flipped. You turned it down for Vision on 2026-11-14.
